rationale: Monza Qualifying & FIA provisional grid (Sept 5): Pierre Gasly took maiden pole (1:21.786, fastest in Q1 & Q3 in upgraded Mercedes-powered Alpine) ahead of P2 George Russell (+0.060s), P3 Charles Leclerc, P4 Lewis Hamilton, P5 Max Verstappen, and P6 Oscar Piastri (3-place grid penalty), with Lando Norris down in P8 and Antonelli at the back.
